name: echo hash cracked
description: Proposal, a hash cracking as a slot machine, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x under a gold padlock with a steel shackle and four little windows in its face): all four windows spin as dithered teal reels while the creature watches with narrowed eyes and blinks, the reels stop left to right with a one row bounce into plain steel tiles while its eyes flick to each, the last one slows over three long frames with a sweat drop running down beside its head, then all four flash green, the shackle springs open with sparkles, its eyes go to happy arches and it pumps a fist twice beside its antenna, before the shackle snaps shut and the reels spin again; judge whether the reels read as spinning and the tiles as stopped without either reading as text, whether the shackle springing reads as unlocked, and whether the fist pump reads at 12 px cells.
